maya: Quick flag — launch + webinar drove sessions +300% but MQLs only +2%. Can we triage attribution before Monday KPI?
noah: Which cohort? organic or paid?
li: Most of the lift is from 'social' short links; UTMs missing on ~27% of sessions from a quick sample.
taylor: We used the shortlink batch for reels and stories. I tweaked cache settings yesterday, might have flipped query stripping.
tracking-bot: shortlink-service deploy at 12:08 UTC — preserve_qs=false (sha: f2a9).
maya: Ok tasks: taylor flip preserve_qs=true and redeploy; li run backfill using click logs; noah add an "unattributed_pct" tile to KPI dashboard and snapshot pre/post.
li: Backfill job started (id: bf-36321). ETA ~4h. I'll drop a partial CSV to /reports/launch_backfill.csv and post progress.
taylor: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.company/shortener/pull/612 — set preserve_qs=true. Rolling now.
tracking-bot: PR merged and canary rolling. No errors reported.
noah: Added KPI tile and set alert at unattributed_pct > 20%. Snapshot (pre-backfill) uploaded: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3632109999_pre.png
maya: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread — if backfill recovers conversions we'll annotate the exec slide; if not, we run a quick CTA A/B and follow-up nurture. :thumbsup:
